title: Sparkly toy block
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='top' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffd45e'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f5b83d'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='front' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f08a3c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d96b22'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='side' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#c25a1c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#a3481a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='studtop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff0a8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffd45e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='studside' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f5b83d'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e09a2a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- main block: front face -->
  <rect x='22' y='46' width='38' height='30' rx='2' fill='url(#front)'/>
  <!-- main block: top face -->
  <polygon points='22,46 44,34 82,34 60,46' fill='url(#top)'/>
  <!-- main block: side face -->
  <polygon points='60,46 82,34 82,64 60,76' fill='url(#side)'/>

  <!-- studs on top face (perspective-ish circles) -->
  <!-- stud 1 -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='7' ry='3.6' fill='url(#studtop)'/>
  <path d='M33 40 L33 43 A7 3.6 0 0 0 47 43 L47 40' fill='url(#studside)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='7' ry='3.6' fill='none' stroke='#c98a1e' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- stud 2 -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='40' rx='7' ry='3.6' fill='url(#studtop)'/>
  <path d='M51 40 L51 43 A7 3.6 0 0 0 65 43 L65 40' fill='url(#studside)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='40' rx='7' ry='3.6' fill='none' stroke='#c98a1e' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- stud 3 -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='40' rx='7' ry='3.6' fill='url(#studtop)'/>
  <path d='M69 40 L69 43 A7 3.6 0 0 0 83 43 L83 40' fill='url(#studside)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='40' rx='7' ry='3.6' fill='none' stroke='#c98a1e' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- face on front: cute eyes and smile, lighter shade -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='3.2' fill='#ffeeb0'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='58' r='3.2' fill='#ffeeb0'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='58' r='1.4' fill='#a3481a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='58' r='1.4' fill='#a3481a'/>
  <path d='M33 66 Q41 72 49 66' fill='none' stroke='#ffeeb0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- sparkle top-left -->
  <path d='M14 14 L16 20 L22 22 L16 24 L14 30 L12 24 L6 22 L12 20 Z' fill='#fff27a'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='22' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle top-right -->
  <path d='M86 18 L87.5 23 L92 24.5 L87.5 26 L86 31 L84.5 26 L80 24.5 L84.5 23 Z' fill='#8ee6ff'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='24.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkle right -->
  <path d='M90 48 L91 52 L95 53 L91 54 L90 58 L89 54 L85 53 L89 52 Z' fill='#fff27a'/>
  <!-- sparkle bottom-left -->
  <path d='M16 62 L17 67 L22 68 L17 69 L16 74 L15 69 L10 68 L15 67 Z' fill='#8ee6ff'/>
  <!-- sparkle bottom-right -->
  <path d='M78 82 L79 86 L83 87 L79 88 L78 92 L77 88 L73 87 L77 86 Z' fill='#fff27a'/>
  <!-- small dots -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='14' r='1.3' fill='#fff27a'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='80' r='1.6' fill='#8ee6ff'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='84' r='1.4' fill='#fff27a'/>
</svg>
